name: Optics Controlling Environment
description: Deep reinforcement learning has the potential to address various scientific problems. In this paper, we implement an optics simulation environment for reinforcement learning based controllers. The environment incorporates nonconvex and nonlinear optical phenomena as well as more realistic time-dependent noise. Then we provide the benchmark results of several state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithms on the proposed simulation environment. In the end, we discuss the difficulty of controlling the real-world optical environment with reinforcement learning algorithms. We will make the code of the paper publicly available.
evaluation_method: mean episodic return (cumulative reward) and task success rate; controller stability and sample efficiency are also reported
reputation: Niche research benchmark used primarily by RL-for-science and control communities; limited mainstream adoption.
notes: Non-LLM simulation environment with realistic time-dependent noise and nonlinear optics — significant sim-to-real gap; environment is research-focused and code/simulations may require domain expertise to reproduce.
